typical_incremental_run.scope: Measured incremental catch-up batch (11,063 input price rows; 5,030 new observations and 346 revisions) including the first Gold build. This is not a steady-state daily median.

dag.analysis: The monthly aggregation executed successfully. Its captured initial EXPLAIN plan reads five required columns using PhotonScan (column pruning), derives the month key in PhotonProject, calculates partial statistics in PhotonGroupingAgg, redistributes groups through PhotonShuffleExchangeSink/Source, and combines them in a final PhotonGroupingAgg under AdaptiveSparkPlan. There is no WHERE predicate in this aggregation, so predicate pushdown is not claimed. The runtime graph screenshot and actual scan/shuffle metrics still require capture; EXPLAIN alone does not certify the final adaptive plan.

finops.enterprise_region: Azure East US - illustrative paid scenario
finops.assumptions: Planning scenario, not measured Azure billing: assume 1 billed DBU per complete serverless job at the official East US Premium Automated Serverless Compute rate of USD 0.45/DBU. Allow USD 5/month storage, USD 48/month for two Power BI Premium Per User licenses (24/user/month paid yearly), and a USD 100/month budget for a short-lived serving warehouse, requests and transfer. These storage/serving amounts are budgets, not vendor quotes. Hourly 24/7 = 8,760 runs/year. No separate VM charge is added to serverless. Before procurement, benchmark paid DBUs and warehouse idle time; 0.5/1/2 DBU per run implies annual totals of USD 3,807 / 5,778 / 9,720 under the same monthly budgets. Taxes, growth and source licensing are excluded. Free Edition exposes no billed DBUs here, so wall time is not converted into fabricated usage.
